other_conditions: Applicant must belong to one of the sub‑castes: Arundathiyar, Chammadiya, Chamar, Chambar, Chamagar, Madar, Madig, Madiga, Mini Madig, Jambavalu, Haralayya, Machigar, Mochigar, Mochi, muchi, Telugu Mochi, kamaati mocha, Rohidas, Dhor, kakkayya, Kankayya, Samagara, Samagar, Aadhi Anddra, Aadhi Dravida, Aadhi Karnataka (all schedule castes)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas and ₹25,000 in urban areas
Applicant or any family member must not have received benefits from other schemes, except training programs
Family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000‑₹1,00,000 worth of procurement per artisan.
